answer_1.quote: We introduce the KMMLU Benchmark-a comprehensive compilation of 35,030 expert-level multiple-choice questions spanning 45 subjects, all sourced from original Korean exams without any translated content.
answer_1.outputs: The models generate answers to multiple-choice questions in a few-shot setting using either Direct or Chain-of-Thought prompting.

answer_2.quote: Average accuracy(%) calculated using the Direct method in a 5-shot setting across the entire test set.
